fig_lifecycle_model_overview: Overview of the reliability-aware lifecycle model. Server SKUs, per-age component reliability, regional grid carbon and demand, and reused-part pools feed a multi-period linear program over fleet cohorts that decides each quarter whether to buy, keep, retire, cascade (in place or to a clean-grid region) or lease capacity. An outer Monte Carlo loop adds latency-critical reserve until every region-quarter meets the target shortfall probability. Outputs are the reuse savings ladder, break-even analyses and the carbon price of a guaranteed SLO.
fig_fleet_carbon_ladder_by_grid: Left: change in 6-year lifecycle carbon relative to the no-reuse fleet, by carbon component, for a failure-blind reuse plan, a reliability-aware reuse plan, and the latter with in-place or geographic cascading; dots mark the net change. Right: reuse savings X (failures ignored), failure-blind, Y (reliability-aware) and Y plus cascading for single-grid fleets on clean, mixed and dirty grids. GPU throughput, power and CXL slowdown are placeholder values.
fig_reliability_breakeven_reused_parts: Fleet carbon saving of reuse versus a multiplier on reused-part failure rates beyond the age effect. The reliability-aware plan degrades gracefully and stops reusing at a multiplier of about 8, never doing worse than no reuse; a plan that ignores failures crosses zero near 2 and becomes increasingly carbon-negative.
fig_cascade_breakeven_energy_efficiency: Additional carbon saving from cascading previous-generation GPU hosts to the batch tier versus their batch work per joule relative to current-generation hosts. Cascading pays only near energy parity; shipping cascaded hosts to the clean-grid region adds further savings once cascading pays.
fig_chance_constrained_slo: Left: reuse saving under a guaranteed latency-critical SLO (per region-quarter shortfall probability of at most 1% or 0.1%) for independent and increasingly correlated failures, with reused parts failing as their age predicts (1x) or three times more (3x). Right: carbon price of the SLO for the reuse plan relative to its expected-value plan.
fig_node_sensitivity_tornado: One-at-a-time sensitivity of the node-level reuse saving (mixed grid, latency-critical tier) to each parameter's range. Bars show the saving with the parameter at the low (blue) and high (orange) ends; the CXL throughput multiplier alone determines the sign of the saving.
fig_carbon_cost_pareto: Carbon-cost epsilon-constraint front of the reference fleet over six years.
